commands.name: install
commands.run: set -eu && sudo apt-get update -qq && sudo DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive apt-get install -y -qq --no-install-recommends git openssl curl ca-certificates libicu-dev && curl -fsSL https://mise.run | MISE_VERSION=2026.11.3 sh && export PATH="$HOME/.local/bin:$HOME/.local/share/mise/shims:$PATH" && mise trust -qy . && mise install

commands.name: test
commands.run: bash -lc 'mise run lint && mise run test'
